title: Empty V-Rack Hay Manger
description: One newly authored whole static pasture feeding fixture: an empty inward-descending V-shaped slatted hay rack with two complete tapered end boards, four longitudinal rails and ten complete sloped slats, above a separate real hollow catch trough, all joined to four ground posts. Twenty-one closed editable meshes and three opaque timber PBR roles. Distinct from a plain stone water trough, the outward-sheet A-frame storage rack, cylindrical fishing feeder cage or two-notched-end uncapping basin. No old model is imported, resized or extracted. Metres, Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Small hidden fixed overlaps support the display. No hay or animals added to hide construction, no animation, animal-fit/entrapment/feed-safety, husbandry, nutrition or engineering-performance guarantee; static game-art appearance only.
